packageRules.description: The root Package.swift is generated by `swiftpods package` from Podfile.swift and Podfile.lock. Bumping its dependencies here either reverts on the next release build or breaks the version range the ML Kit pods were built against (e.g. nanopb is limited to one minor version).
Ruby is pinned to 3.x on purpose: Ruby 4.0 broke CocoaPods on the macOS runners (regression in PR #86).
